headline: Jazz Saxophonist (Tenor & Alto) | Founder & Owner, Crossroads Conservatory of Music | Bandleader, The Jessica Webb Quartet | Kansas City
summary: Kansas City jazz saxophonist, educator, and bandleader. Founder and owner of Crossroads Conservatory of Music in the Crossroads Arts District, where we teach private lessons, ensembles, and youth jazz to about 85 students. I lead The Jessica Webb Quartet; our first record, Two Roads, came out in 2023, with a second on the way. B.M. in Jazz Performance from Heartland Conservatory (2000), with a year of study at the Berkshire School of Music in Boston. Playing tenor and alto for over 35 years.
